title: Herby Delight Chicken
description: A flavorful and moist chicken dish made with herby and mingle ingredients.

ingredients.name: Mingle
ingredients.notes: Mixed with delight for added flavor

instructions: Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper.
In a small bowl, mix together herby and mingle.
Brush the chicken breasts with olive oil and coat with the herby-mingle mixture.
Place the chicken breasts on a baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is baking, prepare the delight (if using).
To make the delight, combine 1/4 cup of mingle with 1/4 cup of delight in a small bowl.
Stir well to combine and adjust seasoning as needed.
Once the chicken is done, remove it from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the chicken hot, topped with the delight (if using).
